pairs.difference: B: the fan leaves are flat, pure magenta-violet from edge to fold. They read as two flat pure hues in the lens, and subject chroma is 0.226, above every real card. The shadowed leaves only get darker; they don't change hue. A: the umbrella canopy is a deeper violet with lit and shaded masses, a white lace rim and a brown handle that rest the eye. Its warm share is high only because of the yellow diamond backdrop.
pairs.fix: Paint the fan leaves a deep, slightly dusty violet, not neon magenta. Let the folds in shadow go toward plum-blue, and give the sticks a muted wood brown.

pairs.difference: B: the phone booth is one pure fire-engine red with almost no variation. The darker sides are the same red, only darker. Apart from small cyan glass and grey handset accents, the card is mostly red on green (2.6 hue families, below the real range), and the green backdrop is louder than on real cards. A: the chest has warm gold and brown wood on a cool blue water backdrop, with muted sand and blue/pink gems as accents. That matches the real warm hero on cool backdrop.
pairs.fix: Make the booth a slightly deeper lacquer red that turns crimson-maroon in shadow. Calm the green backdrop to a softer, less saturated green, and add a neutral grey-silver to the handset and base.

pairs.difference: A: the whole card is pulled warm (warm share 0.859, above the real range): a cream-beige stone fountain on a yellow-striped wall over peach paving. Even the stone's shaded side stays warm. The only cool note is the cyan water. This is the same cream-on-orange drift as the generated computers in the lessons. B: the stand is near-white, with cool lavender shadow on the tablecloth under the stand, and pastel pink and mint cakes. Its shadows turn cool, as on the real computer card.
pairs.fix: Paint the fountain in cool light-grey stone with blue-grey and lavender shadows, not cream. Make the paving a muted grey-beige, and keep the yellow wall as the only strong warm mass.

pairs.difference: B: the navy cap sits on a blue backdrop, so the hero repeats the backdrop's hue, which real cards almost never do. Only the gold rim and tassel break it, and the cap's top reads violet-blue in the lens. A: the black hat is a neutral mass with a red band against cyan. Its low chroma and shadow numbers come from the hat's natural black, not from a palette error.
pairs.fix: Give the cap a deep near-black navy or charcoal with neutral grey highlights so it separates from the blue backdrop. Keep the gold tassel as the single warm accent.

pairs.difference: B: the sneakers carry royal blue, neon lime, teal, hot pink and orange laces, all at full strength. That is 5.5 hue families, above the real range, with no muted local colour. The shadows under the shoes are a flat grey-olive. A: a gold candelabra and cream candles on a teal backdrop, warm hero on cool ground with few families. The teal is dull, but the hue roles are like the real cards.
pairs.fix: Paint the sneakers in one main blue with white soles and a single accent colour on the laces. Drop the extra neon pink, lime and orange, and let the shadow under the shoes go cool blue-violet.

pairs.difference: B: the scarf is one saturated pure red. Subject chroma is 0.217, above every real card, and the folds go only to a darker red without a hue shift. A: the fan is a muted pastel pink with cream lace and ivory sticks on a soft light-blue backdrop, so there is plenty of resting neutral. It is low-chroma but within reason.
pairs.fix: Paint the scarf a slightly softer cotton red with lighter, slightly pinkish lit folds and crimson-maroon shadow folds, so it is less pure and flat.

pairs.difference: B: the pool rings are pure pink, yellow and blue primaries on bright green grass. In the lens the yellow and blue rings melt into the grass greens, so the hero doesn't separate from the ground, and the brown fence adds a third warm mass. A: the red cooler is a warm hero against blue sky and sea, with white neutrals on the lid. Its shadow on the sand goes purple-maroon, a related cool shadow like the real cards.
pairs.fix: Lower the grass to a softer, slightly blue-green and push the shadow around the pool toward blue-teal. Keep the pool rings clear and saturated, but make them slightly less neon.

pattern: Generated cards push the hero toward one pure, flat hue (neon magenta fan, fire-engine red booth and scarf, many neon accents on the sneakers) that is louder than the backdrop. Their shadows only get darker instead of turning to a related cool hue, and whites and stone drift toward warm cream on warm backdrops. Real cards keep a calmer local colour, put a warm hero on a cool ground (or the reverse), and let shadows go blue-violet or plum.
